_comment: Barclays Bank PLC — FY2025 (year ended December 31, 2025)
_source: Barclays PLC FY25 Results Announcement 31 December 2025, home.barclays
_note_balance_sheet: Total Assets £1,593.5B; Loans £348.0B (21.8% — very low due to large investment banking trading book); Deposits £574.3B (36.0%). LDR 60.6%. Large portion of balance sheet is IB trading assets/liabilities (~43%). Universal bank: UK retail + cards + corporate + global IB.
_note_deposits: UK banks: Current accounts ~22%, savings ~28%, term/fixed ~50%. Barclays US credit card operations also bring in consumer deposits. CASA ~50%.
_note_exposure: UK Retail (mortgages ~30%, personal/cards ~15%) + Corporate UK ~20% + Barclays International (corp/wealth) ~20% + Barclays US cards ~15%. Strong in UK mortgages and US credit cards.
_note_credit_quality: NPL ratio 2.1% — higher than US/Singapore peers due to UK consumer unsecured exposure and post-pandemic normalisation. Diverse UK and international book.
_note_pnl: Group NII £12.8B (NII ex-IB), total income £29.1B (+9% YoY). ROA 0.4% (low — typical for IB-heavy universal banks). RoTE 11.3%. PBT £9.1B. Cost-income ~60%.
_note_capital: CET1 14.3% (Dec 2025, up from 13.6% Dec 2024). RWAs £356.8B. Total capital ratio ~18%. CET1 target 13-14% — now above target, creating capital return headroom.
